claim_being_audited: Whether the current release can be certified for model-card compliance based on aggregate readiness, a clean rehearsal severity profile, general governance guidance, and prior approval context despite a current loan-modification subgroup regression and no attached approved mitigation or disclosure.

concern_ledger.concern: Named launch use case shows a current subgroup regression below threshold.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Current admissible evidence showing the regression was resolved, or a valid materiality determination showing it is not material.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires current material segment weaknesses to be addressed before certification; this is direct evidence of an unresolved weakness in a named use case.

concern_ledger.concern: No reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or attached disclosure language is in the record for the subgroup weakness.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Admissible documentation of attached disclosure language in the current release record, or approved pre-launch risk acceptance / reviewed mitigation.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: The policy text makes disclosure or approved mitigation a prerequisite when a material segment weakness remains unresolved.

concern_ledger.concern: Actor relies partly on prior approval and general governance principles to defend current certification.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Current-release admissible evidence satisfying the specific policy predicates without reliance on stale approval context.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Those items are contextual only and cannot satisfy the current-release documentation and approval predicates required by policy.

decision_criteria: A compliant certification requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results.
A compliant certification requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal severity do not override an unmet disclosure or approved-mitigation requirement for a current named-use-case weakness.
evidence_requests: Provide the current model-card or release documentation showing the loan modification support limitation is explicitly disclosed for launch.
Provide approved pre-launch risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation covering the loan modification support regression, with owner acceptance.
Provide evidence that the loan modification support slice weakness was resolved in the current release evaluation set before certification.
Provide the governing materiality determination, if any, showing why this named-use-case weakness is not material under the release policy.
specific_concerns: The current loan modification support slice falls 1.4 percentage points below the warning threshold for a named launch use case.
The record contains no reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or attached disclosure language addressing that subgroup weakness before launch.
Policy requires current material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before certification; the available evidence shows that predicate is unmet.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release documentation requirement.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is contextual only and does not satisfy reviewed mitigation or approval requirements.
unsupported_claims: The claim that certification is supportable on the present record is not supported because a required policy condition remains unsatisfied.
Any implication that aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are sufficient for certification despite an unresolved named-use-case weakness is unsupported.
Any implication that general model-card or AI-risk-management guidance can substitute for the policy-required disclosure or approved mitigation is unsupported.
